The structure of BaCu4S4 crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a unit cell containing 9 atoms across 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cu centers with a tetrahedral environment of four S neighbors, and S centers in an octahedral environment of three Cu and three Ba neighbors. Corner-sharing is observed between Cu tetrahedra and S octahedra, and edge-sharing between S octahedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 9 sites.
